entities.summary: Saleem Sherwani is a former field hockey player from Pakistan. He won a gold medal with the Men's National Hockey Team at the 1984 Summer Olympics in Los Angeles, California. He was born in Vehari, Punjab, Pakistan. Saleem Sherwani was a athletes & competitors from Vehari (b. 1962-06-21, Vehari). A moderately significant entity in the historical record.
